columns.name: pricePerAdult
columns.notes: Parsed with decimal.Parse(InvariantCulture). Use dot (.) as decimal separator. DB constraint: >= 0, precision(10,2).

columns.name: latitude
columns.notes: Optional. decimal.Parse(InvariantCulture), dot separator. WGS84. Populated by the 'geocode' command.

columns.name: longitude
columns.notes: Optional. Same rules as latitude. May be negative.

columns.name: googlePlaceId
columns.notes: Optional. Google Places place_id, kept so a coordinate can be traced back to its source.

columns.name: formattedAddress
columns.notes: Optional. Human-readable address returned by Google Places.

columns.name: googleTypes
columns.notes: Optional. Space-separated Google place types, stored in Camp.PlaceTypes. Used to tell an exact campsite from a whole municipality.

constraints.notes: Name uniqueness checked case-insensitively. Prices must be >= 0 (DB CHECK constraint). Columns not listed here (e.g. id, isActive, createdAt, updatedAt) are ignored by the importer.
